user.title: House View
user.description: Stores your plan, terrain and corrections for the House View card. The location comes from your Home Assistant configuration.

abort.single_instance_allowed: House View is already set up.

github.title: GitHub backup
github.description: Private repository used by the “Back up to GitHub” / “Restore” buttons of the card setup. Leave the repository empty to disable.

lock.title: Edit protection
lock.description: Password asked by the card before the editor (✎) and the setup (⚙) open, to avoid changes made by mistake. Current state: {status}. Leave the field empty to keep the current password. The card asks for it again after 10 minutes without any change.

error.repo_public: This repository is public: use a private one (it holds the plan of your house).
error.cannot_connect: Repository not reachable with this token.

catalog_unknown.message: The catalog has not been checked yet.

catalog_incompatible.message: Catalog {version} needs version {minimum} of the integration or newer.
